# MEMO Studio

MEMO Studio builds computational design tools, BIM automation, generative architecture systems, custom AEC software and fabrication workflows.

Canonical website for this repository: https://memortal.github.io/MEMO-STUDIO-/
Services and work: https://memortal.github.io/MEMO-STUDIO-/services.html

## Service guides
- BIM Automation & Coordination: https://memortal.github.io/MEMO-STUDIO-/services/bim-automation.html
- Generative Architecture & Housing: https://memortal.github.io/MEMO-STUDIO-/services/generative-architecture.html
- Custom Design Software & 3D Tools: https://memortal.github.io/MEMO-STUDIO-/services/aec-design-software.html
- Digital Fabrication & Public Art: https://memortal.github.io/MEMO-STUDIO-/services/parametric-fabrication.html

- AI Design Systems & Research: https://memortal.github.io/MEMO-STUDIO-/services/ai-architecture-research.html
